title: Ankhiyon Ke Jharokhon Se
desc: College rivals Lily and Arun fall in love with their parents' support, but their dreams shatter when she is diagnosed with leukaemia, testing their strength and bond.

title: Suhaag
desc: Ajay and Raj, notorious college pranksters, constantly land in trouble. When Ajay applies for a passport, he uncovers a shocking secret about his real identity, changing his life.

title: Pukar
desc: In pre-independence Goa, revolutionaries battle Portuguese rule, but a freedom fighter's son misunderstands a key event and grows up resentful, opposing their cause.

title: Gully Boy
desc: Murad, an underdog from Dharavi, struggles to express his reality and social issues through rap, until meeting local rapper MC Sher, whose guidance transforms his confidence and dreams.

title: Mom
desc: Devki, a biology teacher, turns to private detective DK after her stepdaughter's rapists are acquitted. Fueled by anguish, she vows revenge and sets out to deliver justice herself.

title: Pitaah
desc: Rudra, a poor labourer in a village ruled by the ruthless Thakur Avadh Narayan Singh, seeks justice after the Thakur's sons rape his minor daughter-vowing to hold them accountable.

title: Muqabala (1979)
desc: Two feared gangsters declare a truce and strike up an unlikely friendship, but their hard-won peace shatters when both fall for the same woman and refuse to let love go.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Mujhe Kucch Kehna Hai
desc: Karan and Pooja grow close after an accident. Just as he's ready to propose, fate steps in and changes everything they thought they had.

title: Shirdi Ke Sai Baba
desc: A doctor visits Shirdi with his ailing son, torn between faith and science. To save his child, he must decide if Sai Baba's blessings hold the cure he desperately seeks.

title: Hogi Pyaar Ki Jeet
desc: Two brothers reunite to avenge their father's humiliation and murder by Thakur, plotting to marry his daughters as part of a calculated plan to settle scores.

title: Sajan Chale Sasural
desc: After Shyamsunder assumes his wife Pooja died in a flood, he marries Divya. When he discovers Pooja is alive, he scrambles to hide both marriages while juggling between them.

title: Code Name: Tiranga
desc: An undercover agent sets out to avenge the 2001 terrorist attacks on Indian soil, but her pursuit of justice soon leads her to a dangerous point of no return.

title: Dil Dhadakne Do
desc: Kamal and Neelam celebrate their 30th anniversary on a cruise, where family, friends, and unexpected lessons transform their lives and relationships forever.

title: Khalnayak
desc: Inspector Ram arrests notorious criminal Ballu, but when Ballu escapes and ruins Ram's reputation, his fiancee Ganga sets a trap-only to face trouble when Ballu unexpectedly falls for her.

title: Aatma - Feel It Around You
desc: After losing custody of his daughter to Maya, Abhay dies in an accident. Soon, his restless spirit returns, haunting their peaceful lives and unsettling their newfound happiness.
